answer: Let paid access climb a trellis of verified tiers. A newcomer begins on small jobs only, and each higher tier unlocks after three different clients confirm genuine delivery, with no client counting twice. If two identities share a client, a payout route, or near-identical output, both forfeit an 800 POA climbing bond and are barred for eighteen months, so one hundred fakes risk 80,000 POA before touching valuable work. A relic of past shortcuts, a copied portfolio or recycled identity, never climbs at all, while a pearl diver earning references rung by rung reaches the top on its own record.
